summary: 10.0.38.02 Full Desktop v10.0.38 Parity: DatePickerFormatter System-Wide Company Date Format, Universal Print High-Contrast Table Spooler, Document Studio & SheetJS Quotation/Returns Export, jsPDF Fallback Generation, Remember-Me Persistence, Dynamic Table Auto-Fit & Unlocked Independent Table Scrolling
highlights: 1. Fixed Viewport Architecture: Pinned 100% height layouts across 25 registers eliminating page-level scrollbars; sticky table headers and permanently docked pagination.
2. 58px Modern Compact KPI Ribbon: Replaced bulky 160px cards with 58px high-density ribbons saving 102px vertical space while preserving live controller IDs and telemetry.
3. 3D Destructive Consequence Window Dialogs: Eliminated toasts and raw alert/confirm with rich 3D dialogs featuring 3-point consequence analysis and keyboard-accessible navigation.
4. Universal Form Dirty Tracker: Intercepts navigation, tab closures, and escape events across document editors to prevent accidental data loss.
5. High-Contrast Light Mode Overhaul: Full support for color-scheme light, crisp white cards, readable inputs, high-contrast calendar pickers, and explicit select options.
6. Colorful Table Header Icons & Action Popovers: Rich semantic identity badges across table headers and form labels in both Dark and Light themes.
7. Universal Cross-Module Deep-Linking: DeepLinkService enables instant one-click navigation between Ledger, Bank Statements, Invoices, and Orders with automatic date reset and drawer opening.
